changeSet.author: thonbecker
changeSet.comment: Prevent games from referencing players belonging to another tenant
changeSet.sql:
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uk_players_tenant_id_id ON foosball.players (tenant_id, id);
ALTER TABLE foosball.games ADD CONSTRAINT fk_games_white_player1_same_tenant FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, white_team_player1_id) REFERENCES foosball.players (tenant_id, id); ALTER TABLE foosball.games ADD CONSTRAINT fk_games_white_player2_same_tenant FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, white_team_player2_id) REFERENCES foosball.players (tenant_id, id); ALTER TABLE foosball.games ADD CONSTRAINT fk_games_black_player1_same_tenant FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, black_team_player1_id) REFERENCES foosball.players (tenant_id, id); ALTER TABLE foosball.games ADD CONSTRAINT fk_games_black_player2_same_tenant FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, black_team_player2_id) REFERENCES foosball.players (tenant_id, id);
